title: Data management Sequence - steps not executing
author: Unknown
content: I am encountering an issue with a Data Management Sequence consisting of four steps. The first step is not executing as expected.
solution_text: You can trigger DM sequences by using BRApi.Utilities.StartDataMgmtSequence, BRApi.Utilities.ExecuteDataMgmtSequence, or BRApi.Utilities.QueueDataMgmtSequence. ExecuteDataMgmtSequence fully executes the first DM sequence before the next one.
